name: Critical Result Acknowledgement SLA (24h)
description: Critical result with no patient acknowledgement within 24 hours creates an immediate coordinator call task and GP notification.

action.description: Patient with critical HbA1c not acknowledged after 24 hours. Voice call required.

name: High Result Acknowledgement SLA (72h)
description: High abnormal result with no patient acknowledgement within 72 hours sends a secondary reminder in preferred language, then queues a call task.

action.description: High abnormal result unacknowledged for 72 hours. Secondary reminder sent; call required.

name: Teach-Back Needs Assistance
description: When teach-back responses indicate confusion or needs help, create a coordinator call task with interpreter flag.

action.description: Patient requested help or struggled during teach-back verification. Coordinate direct outreach.

name: Referral Inaction Escrow Check (48h/72h)
description: Referral sent with no receiving specialist response within 48h reminds receiver; after 72h escalates to Programme Manager.

action.description: Referral pending specialist acceptance for over 48 hours. Escrow remains with sender.

name: Referral Rejection Document Checklist Return
description: Specialist referral rejection immediately returns accountable ownership to referring GP with missing item checklist.

action.description: Referral rejected by specialist. Actionable checklist returned to GP for remediation.

name: Appointment No-Show Patient Outreach
description: Appointment marked NO_SHOW creates immediate reschedule task and triggers patient re-engagement message.

action.description: Patient missed specialist appointment. Reschedule task created with barrier inquiry.

name: Specialist Outcome Delayed (14 Days)
description: Specialist visit attended but clinical outcome report not returned within 14 days; triggers chase and PM alert.

action.description: Appointment attended 14 days ago without returned outcome. Chase note sent to specialist facility.

name: Critical Case Review Delayed (48h)
description: Critical result without clinician review within 48 hours escalates directly to Facility Clinical Lead.

action.description: Critical case unreviewed by referring clinician after 48 hours. Urgent safety escalation.
